column1: # The RS30 Ultra Max recipe (g0155): steps of tools/build/engine.py, WHEN<TAB>OP<TAB>ARGS. Test images only (trial).
# Base: its own arm32 LineageOS 21 TV GSI built with uffd GC, AOSP test keys. The changes are the X50 test
# image's pieces that apply to this vendor: every APEX uncompressed (no .capex left for apexd's first boot), the debloat
# of debloat.txt (setup wizard, sample launcher, updater, emulator overlays), identity and model props (USB in host
# mode and a TV, as stock), network adb, the vendor app folders hidden (XGIMI-key system apps abort PackageManager), the
# X50 blobs reader with rs30_blobs_allow.txt and the stock eye-protection drawer (in a trial read only from the stock
# slot), Lumen's key layouts and input configs with the user power keys back to POWER (x50_power_keys.py), and with the
# Mac's signed stage (!unsigned) the platform set on the g0155 key, X50EyeGuard (boot handshake, eye-protection
# fail-safe), X50Projector (menu, remote), X50PowerOverlay (power, gear and projector keys to their apps) and X50TvInput
# (org.lumen.tvinput, the HDMI inputs behind the input and game rows).
# Flags: test (tN), unsigned (--unsigned: the same tree without the stage, a host build check only).
!unsigned
!unsigned
# the stock kernel of the dump has what the base needs: the userfaultfd GC and 32-bit compat
# the pinned base: 32-bit only, built for the uffd GC, its boot image compiled for it (else odrefresh compiles the
# boot classpath before zygote)
# the tree: the base copy with every APEX uncompressed (as the HB and Play 6 images: apexd would unpack each .capex
# during post-fs-data, late for the vendor's PWM watchdog on this 32-bit userspace; original_apex is the same signed
# APEX), the platform set on the g0155 key (a signed APEX goes over the unpacked one), identity and model props
!unsigned
# debloat (debloat.txt): no classpath APEX, no provisioning app, the one HOME and the vendor's VNDK APEX stay
# the vendor app folders hidden, network adb, the blobs reader with the eye-protection drawer
# a 0-byte placeholder for every allow-listed file without bind= (the reader binds the verified copy over it); the
# base must not have a real one (tools/devices/test/build_check_test.sh keeps this list equal to the allow list)
# the remote keys, as the X50 image: the vendor's layouts use XGIMI labels this framework rejects (a whole file then
# falls back to Generic.kl: power = mute, gear = F8), so Lumen's layouts and input configs go to /system/product/usr
# (searched first) and the user power keys back to the system POWER. The RS30's own 000d:3840 scancodes (stock
# PICTURE_MODE, SHORTCUT_1 / 2, PRO_SETTING, BRIGHTNESS) stay unmapped: no stock handler proven.
# the registry apps, platform apps on the g0155 key, and every APK and APEX of the tree for the Mac's S1 check
# (tools/devices/sign_device.py g0155 check-image TAG)
